candidate.title: Duplicate calendar events when destination calendars contain duplicate (credentialId, externalId) entries
reports: handlenewbooking.ts:~990-1000, 1071 — no dedup of destination calendars: shared team calendars produce duplicate entries, causing createallcalendarevents to call createevent twice with the same credentialid and create two identical events on that calendar

packages/core/eventmanager.ts:339 — createallcalendarevents does not dedupe destinations, so when the event-type destination and a collective host's personal destination resolve to the same credential/externalid two identical events are created in that calendar.

handlenewbooking.ts:1003-1010/1085-1087: organizer's and teammates' destination calendars are combined without deduplication, so a teammate sharing the same credential+externalid as the organizer causes createevent to be invoked twice against the same calendar, producing duplicate calendar events
